name: spasi-sohrani
description: /spasi-sohrani and /spasi-vibe show or hide seven icons above the prompt; the icons also appear by themselves on dangerous commands, a full context and compaction

iconSize.title: Icon size (px)
iconSize.description: Height of each icon in the desktop app, in CSS pixels

autoSet.title: Auto icon set
autoSet.description: Set shown by itself on a dangerous command, a full context or compaction

onDanger.title: Show on dangerous commands
onDanger.description: Show the icons when Claude runs rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard and the like

contextThreshold.title: Context threshold (%)
contextThreshold.description: Show the icons with a /compact hint once the context is this full; 100 turns it off
